primary_releases.name: Eli Lilly
primary_releases.body_excerpt: Let’s share the care Caregiving too often falls on one person. Find one thing you can take off their plate. November 25, 2026 This holiday season, let’s take something off a caregiver’s plate. In many families, one person spends the whole year taking care of everything: the appointments, the paperwork, the late-night calls, the worry. A comedy sketch got the world talking about it. Thousands of you declared, "I am Sister." Many of us at Lilly did too. Sister isn't always your sister. It can be a sibling, a partner or a friend. So as we gather around the table, let's do more than say thank you.

primary_releases.original_title: Alvotech to appeal US preliminary injunction decision relating to AVT05
primary_releases.body_excerpt: Back Alvotech to appeal US preliminary injunction decision relating to AVT05 Company Announcement 26 November 2026 Alvotech intends to appeal the preliminary injunction and request an expedited hearing. The injunction relates to a single process patent that Alvotech believes it does not infringe and is confident to prevail on appeal. Alvotech still expects AVT05 to be one of the first US biosimilars to Simponi. The company’s order book and demand outlook remains strong, and Alvotech remains optimistic about its growth prospects.
